name: Younger of Lot
overview: The Younger of Lot is a female figure identified in Scripture primarily as the mother of Ben-ammi. She is noted as a daughter of Lot, linking her directly to the family of Abraham's nephew. Beyond her role as mother and daughter, little else is recorded about her personally.
namesAndTitles: The designation 'Younger of Lot' is a descriptive title found in Genesis 19:31 and does not carry a specific Hebrew or Greek meaning provided in the text. It serves to distinguish her within Lot's family rather than as a formal personal name.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that she is a daughter of Lot and the mother of Ben-ammi. These relationships establish her place within the biblical genealogy connected to Lot's lineage, but no further family details are given.
scriptureSignificance: The Younger of Lot holds significance as the progenitor of Ben-ammi, a figure who becomes the ancestor of the Ammonites, a people frequently mentioned in the Old Testament. Through her, the narrative links Lot's family to the origins of a distinct nation, underscoring God's sovereign plan in the unfolding of biblical history. Her mention, though brief, anchors important genealogical and covenantal themes within the broader biblical story.
